title: Bist du bei mir (aria), arr. for trumpet
video_use_ideas: Gentle solo line under a personal or memorial moment.
legal_notes: Composition PD worldwide (J. S. Bach d.1750). Mutopia piece 257 ('Aria Bist Du Bei Mir', for Trumpet); licence shown as Public Domain on the piece page, in the Mutopia RDF and in the .ly header (placed in the public domain by typesetter Shamim Mohamed). Edition source: Transcribed. Solo-trumpet transcription of the vocal line by the Mutopia typesetter (source: 'Transcribed'), placed in the public domain by that typesetter. Attributed to Bach in the Anna Magdalena Notebook; now usually credited to Gottfried Heinrich Stölzel (d.1749). Both composers are long PD. No pre-rendered preview: the site plays the score MIDI with an in-browser General MIDI synth; no third-party recording.
licence_meaning: PD / CC0 / PDM / US-gov recording and score. Commercial use, no credit needed (courtesy credit still listed where the source asks).
